patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff applies cleanly to the OpenThread checkout, and the instrumented fixed original still executes `FillNetworkDataTlv`, `AppendNetworkData`, and `Message::Write` on the original PoC while lowering the serialized Network Data length from 255 to 249. The fixed run stays clean because the required base-TLV length bound is satisfied and the generic append size no longer exceeds the 257-byte `NetworkDataTlv` stack object.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side parse on the crashing path that materializes attacker-controlled Thread Network Data bytes into stack object `networkData`.

The maximum leader network-data size is defined as 255 even though generic base TLVs only allow lengths up to 254 and reserve 255 as the extended-length marker. Allowing leader network data to reach 255 makes later MLE Network Data serialization encode a base TLV with the reserved length byte, which generic `ot::Tlv::GetSize()` then misinterprets as an `ExtendedTlv`.
ASan sink. `Write()` copies from stack `NetworkDataTlv tlv` using an append size that generic TLV logic inflated beyond the object's real extent.
Immediately before `aMessage.AppendTlv(tlv)`, the generic TLV size derived from the stored length byte is larger than the real `NetworkDataTlv tlv` stack object.
Intermediate runtime event fill_network_data_bound materialized from verified transition assertion A-LENGTH-REACHES-APPEND-SIZE.

edges.description: The full leader network-data length copied into `length` is recorded unchanged in the temporary MLE `NetworkDataTlv` length byte before generic sizing runs.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `fill_network_data_bound.network_data_length == append_network_data_size.stored_length`.

edges.description: The inflated generic append size computed for the temporary `NetworkDataTlv` is the same total source span still being copied when `Message::Write()` reaches the crashing iteration.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `append_network_data_size.append_size == message_write_sink.tracked_append_size`.
